_about: The Saturday Note: one Substack Note each Saturday that points at the weekly edition, made by content-engine like every Note (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-26: content-engine makes every asset, Substack Notes words and images included; Growth only schedules it in Buffer). Read by scripts/post-pack/saturday_note.py. Its links follow the edition contract (the shared edition-contract.md, 25 Nov 2026; growth PR 144 engine/route.py): it carries TWO links, or Growth's subscribe gate refuses it (growth 144 tests/test_subscribe_route_spec.py, test_an_edition_link_never_stands_in_for_a_channels_own_link): the edition link at place note, credited to the newsletter, and the channel's own subscribe link.
signed: Signed by Krish like every Note: it goes out from his own Substack account, in his first person where it helps, and never names him in the text.

image.rule: An image comes only from the Library's social-note-image (config/asset-routes.json notes-image). While that kind is a gap it is refused, and the Note goes out as words only.

filed: 3 Posts/<Saturday> Sat edition - makeyourmindup weekly/0 Publish/saturday-note.json, beside the edition's draft

writer.head: You write one short Substack Note that points the reader at this week's makeyourmindup edition, which goes out today.
rules: Open on the one thing in this week's edition the reader would most want to know, named plainly.
Say in a sentence or two why it matters to the reader's work and money now. No list of everything in the edition.
Plain British English, warm and humble, first person where it helps. Never write his name, and never name mind/make, Mindmake or CTRL.
No em dashes, no exclamation marks, no hashtags, no emojis, no links, no @ mentions: the two links are added after your words.
No prediction, odds or dated call.
Never ask the reader to share, send, forward, tag, repost, like, comment or follow.
Between {min} and {max} words. Answer with the words only.
